dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Observed 4-5 irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region. These features exhibit sharp pixel intensity transitions from the dark exterior background to a high-intensity perimeter (near-white), enclosing an interior region of lower pixel intensity. The perimeters are non-geometric and exhibit high-frequency jitter in their boundary paths.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters (~2-8 pixel diameter) lacking internal gradients. These are concentrated most heavily along the lower ventral-lateral edge and the posterior tail region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented longitudinally towards the anterior-dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, high-intensity linear streak is visible on the lower posterior flank, oriented diagonally relative to the body's longitudinal axis, differing in morphology from the circular texture topology.
